summary.name: Puppet Animation (supplemental design reference, category Animation Techniques)
summary.visualIdentity: Articulated figures, identifiable materials, stable costumes, and miniature sets. Poses must show weight, balance, and foot contact. Avoid rubber-like deformation, costume flicker, and joint intersections. Physical puppet photography must be labeled distinctly from digital rigged animation.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: character drama, and whimsical narrative shorts or theatrical brand stories when paired with a compatible style. Explicit: educational puppet pieces and story chapters with hybrid annotation. Inferred: topics where one expressive character carries the message.
summary.limitations: The source lists no direct renderer and requires photographed physical puppets or a labeled Blender rig simulation. Physical production is frame-by-frame posing. A simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production or validated physics. Source does not name a specific style collection entry.
summary.palette: Palette is a reference-dependent example, not an intrinsic style palette. Tokens: background #EDE4D1, foreground #414638, accent #8E8263, applied only to new presentation elements. Costumes, sets, and photographed materials keep their colors. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background measures 7.701. Accent on background measures 3.009, decorative only.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Motion follows the chosen production method. Held replacement poses are valid, but stop-motion stepping is not imposed by the style name. Video state derives from composition time. Five optional catalog patterns (gaze tracking, miniature parallax, orbit, chapter transitions, storytelling) apply only when scene geometry supports them. Live pointer or scroll input is for interactive delivery only and never required for video export.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified by the style. Suggested options include background music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience, or silence, chosen for topic, reading holds, and motion cadence. Explicit user audio and supplied assets take priority. Speech must remain intelligible, unclipped, and synchronized with picture. No audio layer is mandatory.
summary.assetRequirements: Requires prepared puppet layers or numbered frame sequences with transparency, consistent dimensions, and clear naming. Inspect assets before composition and state any missing ones. Local fonts and assets must load before rendering. Font families are unspecified. Source photographs, costumes, and materials remain unaltered.
summary.combinations: Suggested: style-104 for axial symmetry and frontal framing of miniature sets, with lateral or axial camera moves and feet kept in contact. Suggested: style-024 for brief handwritten notes on held shots only, using #414638 with the #8E8263 accent, never covering faces. Combinations are suggestions, not requirements.
summary.productionApproach: Visual construction uses physical puppet photography frame by frame, or a labeled Blender rig with held keyframes. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition, timing, audio sync, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only under documented conditions. FFmpeg encodes sequences. Verify seeks, key frames, transitions, and loop seams.
